newsitem.title: CHINA: China trade surplus $3.8 bln in Jan-Feb - customs.
newsitem.headline: China trade surplus $3.8 bln in Jan-Feb - customs.

text.p: China posted a trade surplus of $3.8 billion for the first two months of this year compared with a deficit of $439 million for the same period of last year, showed customs figures issued by state television on Friday.
Note: Figures in billions of U.S. dollars.
Exports were up 20.5 percent compared with the first two months of last year, customs said.
Imports fell by 2.8 percent compared with the year-ago period, the figures showed.
Exports of general products rose sharply, the figures showed.
Imports of investment equipment fell, the figures showed.
